The '''Republic Navy War College''',<ref name="BMF 35" /> or '''Anaxes War College''', was a [[university]] on the [[planet]] [[Anaxes]]. Commissioned just [[Standard month|months]] after the [[Clone Wars]] in the newly [[Proclamation of the New Order|established]] [[Imperial Navy]], [[Kassius Konstantine]] was a student of the Anaxes War College, and was one of the first in the new generation of [[Imperial officer|officers]] of the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Dawn" /> The military field manuals used by the Empire were written by Anaxes War College instructors, along with other important military thinkers.<ref name="G&G">''[[Gadgets and Gear]]''</ref> The college was also responsible for the creation of the [[Anaxes War College System]], which served to classify various [[capital ship]]s depending on their size, role, and firepower.<ref name="Battles that Changed the Galaxy">''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Anaxes War College was first mentioned in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in [[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 35|''Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon'' 35]],<ref name="BMF 35" /> a [[De Agostini]] magazine> released around [[September 2]], [[2015]].<ref name="BMFdate">{{BuildFalconDates|35}}</ref>
